'''Danilo Gallinari''' (Sant'Angelo Lodigiano, [[August 8]], [[1988]]) is an [[Italy|Italian]] [[basketball]] player, currently playing for [[Armani Jeans Milano|Olimpia Milano]] in the [[Serie A (basketball)|Italian Lega A]].<ref>[http://195.56.77.208/player/?id=GAL-DAN-88 Lega A page on Gallinari]</ref> He is 6'9" (2.05 meters) tall and plays as a [[small forward]], but he can play as all 5 positions on the basketball court.

==Family==
Gallinari's father, [[Vittorio Gallinari]] played for [[Olimpia Milano]], [[Pallacanestro Pavia]], [[Virtus Bologna]] and [[Scaligera Basket Verona]] in [[Italy]]. He was also a teammate & roommate of current [[New York Knicks]] head coach [[Mike D'Antoni]].

==NBA career==
He is currently listed as a [[NBA Draft|lottery pick]] by several [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] [[scouts]] and [[General Managers|GMs]]<ref>[http://basketboltr.net/2008/05/09/danilo-gallinari-to-play-italy/ danilo gallinari to play italy]</ref>. His recently-signed contract with Olimpia Milano has an [[escape clause]] to the NBA, which virtually creates no hurdles to his passage to The NBA.

==EuroLeague career==
Gallinari began playing professionally in 2004 for Casalpusterlengo, a team in the Italian Serie B League. In 2005, Gallinari was selected by [[Olimpia Milano|Armani Jeans Milano]] and played for [[Nuova Pallacanestro Pavia|Edimes Pavia]] in the Italian [[LegADue]] (Serie A2) championship 2005-2006 . In [[2006]], he was recalled by his team [[Olimpia Milano|Armani Jeans Milano]] to play in the 2006-2007 [[Serie A (basketball)|Italian Lega A]] championship and the European Uleb Cup.

Even though he played only half of the season, in 2006 he was nominated best Italian player of LegADue championship.
He made instant impact on courts around the continent this season and has been rewarded with the [[Euroleague 2007-08]] Rising Star Trophy.
